uiLanguage.name: Module language
uiLanguage.hint: Language of Session Chronicle on this device. "Like Foundry" follows Foundry's language. Pages and cards are written in the language of the GM who records.

theme.name: Look
theme.hint: Signature shows the window and the cards on warm paper, Foundry keeps them dark like the rest of Foundry.

recording.name: Record game nights
recording.hint: The module notes what happens while players are online and writes one page for each session.

recordAlone.name: Record without players
recordAlone.hint: Also note facts when you are the only one online. Off by default, so your preparation does not turn into a session.

gapHours.name: Hours between two sessions
gapHours.hint: A new session starts when something happens after this many hours of quiet.

autoPage.name: Write the page by itself
autoPage.hint: The page is written when nothing has happened for a while or when the last player leaves. You can always write it yourself.

idleMinutes.name: Minutes of quiet before writing
idleMinutes.hint: How long nothing must happen before the page is written.

previously.name: Previously card
previously.hint: At the start of the next session a card in the chat tells everyone what happened last time.

missed.name: What you missed
missed.hint: A player who comes late or comes back after a break gets a private card with what happened in the meantime.

missedMinutes.name: Minutes before a player has missed something
missedMinutes.hint: A player who was away for less than this gets no card.

playerAccess.name: Players may read the Chronicle
playerAccess.hint: Everyone can open the pages. Switch off to keep the journal for the GM. The Previously card then has no open button, but it still tells players a short version in the chat. Turn that off with the Previously card setting.

partnerData.name: Use other Sephral modules
partnerData.hint: Adds the numbers, photos and loot of Combat Log and Stats, Campaign Album and Loot Ledger when they are active.

highlights.name: Note natural 20s and 1s
highlights.hint: Public d20 rolls of the players with a natural 20 or 1 appear under Big moments.

shown.name: Note shown pictures and handouts
shown.hint: What you show to the players appears under Shown at the table.

Menu.title: Session Chronicle
Menu.hint: The running session and the pages of past sessions.

SELFTEST.Title: Self test
SELFTEST.Hint: Checks after an update that everything the module relies on is there.
SELFTEST.NewVersions: Foundry is newer than the verified version ({versions}). Run the self test if something looks wrong.
SELFTEST.NoPartners: No other Sephral module that adds data to the pages is active.
SELFTEST.Journal: Foundry's journals are built differently than expected. Pages cannot be written.
SELFTEST.Chat: Foundry's chat is built differently than expected. The cards cannot be posted.
SELFTEST.Ownership: Foundry's permission levels are built differently than expected. Players may not be able to read the pages.
SELFTEST.Users: Foundry's user list is built differently than expected. Attendance and the active GM cannot be found.
SELFTEST.Socket: Foundry's socket is missing. Shown pictures and handouts are not noticed.
SELFTEST.Documents: Foundry's scenes, combats or links are missing.
SELFTEST.State: The saved state of the module cannot be read.
SELFTEST.Logic: Finding sessions and writing the pages gives wrong results.

DEBUG.Title: Debug file
DEBUG.Hint: One file about all of Sephral’s modules in this world, for bug reports. It contains chat text and whispers.
DEBUG.Saved: Debug file saved: {file}. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
